title: Disk space exhausted
briefing: The application starts returning errors. Logs stop updating and the instance reports very high disk usage.

artifacts.logs: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device

options.text: Investigate disk usage, safely rotate or clean unnecessary files, and verify available space

options.why_wrong: More workers will not create additional disk space.

options.text: Disable the load balancer health check
options.why_wrong: Disabling health checks does not resolve the full disk.
The error identifies a filesystem capacity problem, not a database connection problem.

explanation: The root filesystem has reached 100% usage. The application cannot write files, which can cause logging and request failures.
lesson: Monitor disk usage and log growth. Identify large files before deleting anything, rotate logs safely, and expand storage if recurring demand requires it.
hints: Look at the operating system error in the logs.
What does Errno 28 mean when an application tries to write a file?
